criteria.requirement: Repair the actual Natsort CLI numeric filtering: default int/i mode must preserve arbitrary-size integer tokens and exact decimal thresholds through argument parsing, inclusive range/reverse-range and exclusion comparisons. Do not round thresholds or tokens to float; fractional boundaries compare without truncation. Float/f/real/r retain existing float semantics. Invalid or nonfinite integer thresholds fail clearly. Preserve sorting, sign/exponent policy, Unicode token recognition and ordinary CLI behavior.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
